beschrijving: Rapport opgebouwd via opvolgende SQL queries per niveau.

levels.queryTemplate: WITH RECURSIVE object_tree(id) AS (SELECT :startId UNION SELECT rv.target_id FROM object_tree ot JOIN relation_values rv ON rv.source_id = ot.id WHERE rv.deleted_at IS NULL) SELECT o.label AS Header1, o.id AS startId, p.value, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pv.parameter_id = '019fad6f-c149-7795-b3e5-751c8b2b7949' THEN CAST(pv.value AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totaal_aantal_insecten, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pv.parameter_id = '019fce6b-626f-7609-b67c-17fb251e36e7' THEN pv.value END) AS aantal_soorten FROM objects o LEFT JOIN parameter_values p ON o.id = p.target_id AND p.parameter_id = '019fc74c-cf8c-74ff-a3b6-b6d21c651a19' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN object_tree ot ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN parameter_values pv ON pv.target_id = ot.id AND pv.target_type = 'object' AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE o.id = :startId AND o.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY o.id, o.label, p.value;
levels.tekstTemplate:
Totaal aantal insekten is nu {{totaal_aantal_insecten}} een test van de11212121 tekst template {{value}} voor niveau 0.
De waarde van Header1 is: {{Header1}}

levels.queryTemplate: SELECT o.label AS Header2, o.id AS Id2, (WITH RECURSIVE branch_tree(id) AS (SELECT o.id UNION SELECT r.target_id FROM branch_tree bt JOIN relation_values r ON r.source_id = bt.id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pv.parameter_id = '019fad6f-c149-7795-b3e5-751c8b2b7949' THEN CAST(pv.value AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM branch_tree bt JOIN parameter_values pv ON pv.target_id = bt.id AND pv.target_type = 'object' AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL) AS tak_totaal_insecten, (WITH RECURSIVE branch_tree(id) AS (SELECT o.id UNION SELECT r.target_id FROM branch_tree bt JOIN relation_values r ON r.source_id = bt.id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pv.parameter_id = '019fce6b-626f-7609-b67c-17fb251e36e7' THEN pv.value END) FROM branch_tree bt JOIN parameter_values pv ON pv.target_id = bt.id AND pv.target_type = 'object' AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL) AS tak_aantal_soorten FROM relation_values rv JOIN objects o ON o.id = rv.target_id WHERE rv.source_id = :startId AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND rv.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY rv.volgorde
levels.tekstTemplate:
Totaal aantal insekten is nu {{tak_totaal_insecten}} een test van de tekst template {{value}} voor niveau 1.
De waarde van Header2 is: {{Header2}}

levels.queryTemplate: SELECT o.label AS Header3, o.id AS Id3 FROM objects o JOIN relation_values rv ON rv.target_id = o.id WHERE rv.source_id = :Id2 AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND rv.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY rv.volgorde
SELECT o.label AS Header4, o.id AS Id4 FROM objects o JOIN relation_values rv ON rv.target_id = o.id WHERE rv.source_id = :Id3 AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND rv.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY rv.volgorde

SELECT o.label AS Header5, o.id AS Id5, p_aantal.value AS aantal, p_gegeven.value AS gegeven_taxon_naam, p_formeel.value AS formele_taxon_naam, rt.nl_naam AS nl_naam, (SELECT json_extract(value, '$.name') FROM json_each(rt.taxonomische_boom) WHERE json_extract(value, '$.rank') = 'family') AS familie FROM objects o JOIN relation_values rv ON rv.target_id = o.id LEFT JOIN parameter_values p_aantal ON p_aantal.target_id = o.id AND p_aantal.parameter_id = '019fad6f-c149-7795-b3e5-751c8b2b7949' AND p_aantal.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN parameter_values p_gegeven ON p_gegeven.target_id = o.id AND p_gegeven.parameter_id = '019fce6b-626f-7609-b67c-17fb251e36e7' AND p_gegeven.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN parameter_values p_formeel ON p_formeel.target_id = o.id AND p_formeel.parameter_id = '019fd14a-991d-7265-b929-8da2ee294507' AND p_formeel.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN relevante_taxa rt ON rt.taxon_naam = p_formeel.value AND p_formeel.value != 'niet bekend in COL' AND rt.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE rv.source_id = :Id4 AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND rv.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY rv.volgorde
levels.tekstTemplate: Aantal insekten is nu {{aantal}}, de Nederlandse naam: {{nl_naam}}, de formele naam: {{formele_taxon_naam}} en de familie: {{familie}}
